dialogues.jp: 気がつくと、学校に来ていた。
dialogues.en: Before I knew it, I ended up at school.
dialogues.text: Before I knew it, I ended up at school.

dialogues.jp: やっぱり、心配だ。
dialogues.en: In the end, I couldn't stop my worrying.
dialogues.text: In the end, I couldn't stop my worrying.

dialogues.jp: 巫女部のこと、もちろん、環の身体のこと……。
dialogues.en: About the Miko Club, and of course, about Tamaki...
dialogues.text: About the Miko Club, and of course, about Tamaki...

dialogues.jp:
俺が無理矢理、環を連れて帰ってしまったため、
恐らく部員達には不満が残っている筈だ。
dialogues.en:
Given how I forcibly took Tamaki home, I was fully expecting
the wrath of the club members.
dialogues.text:
Given how I forcibly took Tamaki home, I was fully expecting
the wrath of the club members.

dialogues.jp:
相当具合悪そうだったから、一日や二日で良く
なっているとも思えないけど……。
dialogues.en:
The way I treated them, I doubt they'd just forgive me in a
few days...
dialogues.text:
The way I treated them, I doubt they'd just forgive me in a
few days...

dialogues.jp:
あの後、巫女部がどうなったか、やっぱり気に
なる。様子を見に行こう。
dialogues.en:
I was worried about how the Miko Club was like after, so I
went back to take a look.
dialogues.text:
I was worried about how the Miko Club was like after, so I
went back to take a look.

dialogues.jp: 合宿はなくても、たぶん部活はしてるはずだ。
dialogues.en:
Without the training camp, there'd probably be other club
activities...
dialogues.text:
Without the training camp, there'd probably be other club
activities...

dialogues.jp: 巫女部の部室へと向かう途中。
dialogues.en: I walked closer to the Miko Club clubroom.
dialogues.text: I walked closer to the Miko Club clubroom.

dialogues.jp: ……あれ？
やけに静かだな……。
dialogues.en: It's a lot quieter than usual...
dialogues.text: It's a lot quieter than usual...

dialogues.jp:
確かに、今日はゴールデンウィーク中だから、
他の部もほとんど試合に行って、静かなのはわ
かる。
dialogues.en:
Although it is Golden Week, and a lot of the other clubs
were out for games...
dialogues.text:
Although it is Golden Week, and a lot of the other clubs
were out for games...

dialogues.jp:
が、それにしても、祝詞の声が聞こえないなん
て……。
dialogues.en: I couldn't hear the usual ritual voices either...
dialogues.text: I couldn't hear the usual ritual voices either...

dialogues.jp:
普段なら、まずありえない。祝詞の練習くらい
環がいなくてもできるはずだ。
dialogues.en:
That's unacceptable... even if Tamaki's not around, they can
still practice that at least.
dialogues.text:
That's unacceptable... even if Tamaki's not around, they can
still practice that at least.

dialogues.jp:
不思議に思いつつも、俺は巫女部のドアを開け
る。
dialogues.en: Filled with curiosity, I opened the door to the clubroom.
dialogues.text: Filled with curiosity, I opened the door to the clubroom.

dialogues.speaker: Club Member 1
dialogues.jp: 「あ、先輩。こんにちは」
dialogues.en: "Ah, senpai. Good afternoon."
dialogues.text: "Ah, senpai. Good afternoon."

dialogues.jp:
中には、一番最初に入部希望に来た二人がいる
だけで、あとは誰もいない。
dialogues.en: There were only the first two members of the club inside.
dialogues.text: There were only the first two members of the club inside.

dialogues.jp: 「あれ？　他の人たちは？」
dialogues.en: "Ehh? Where's the others?"
dialogues.text: "Ehh? Where's the others?"

dialogues.jp: 俺が聞くと、
dialogues.en: In reply,
dialogues.text: In reply,

dialogues.speaker: Club Member 2
dialogues.jp:
「うーん……、実は、やめるって連絡がありま
　して」
dialogues.en: "Um... a bunch of them quit the club."
dialogues.text: "Um... a bunch of them quit the club."

dialogues.jp: と言う。
dialogues.en: She said.
dialogues.text: She said.

dialogues.jp: 「やめた？　何人やめたんだよ」
dialogues.en: "Quit? How many?"
dialogues.text: "Quit? How many?"

dialogues.jp: 俺は驚いて尋ねる。
dialogues.en: I worriedly enquired.
dialogues.text: I worriedly enquired.

dialogues.jp: 二人は顔を見合わせ、
dialogues.en: The two of them looked at each other,
dialogues.text: The two of them looked at each other,

dialogues.speaker: Club Member
dialogues.jp: 「その……私達、二人以外は、全員です」
dialogues.en: "Well... besides us two... everyone."
dialogues.text: "Well... besides us two... everyone."

dialogues.jp: げ、マジで。
dialogues.en: Oh geez.
dialogues.text: Oh geez.

dialogues.speaker: Club Member 2
dialogues.jp:
「合宿がなくなったのが、大きかったみたいで
　すよ」
dialogues.en: "No training camp seemed to be a big issue with them."
dialogues.text: "No training camp seemed to be a big issue with them."

dialogues.jp: まさか……やめるとは思わなかった。
dialogues.en: I didn't think they'd quit...
dialogues.text: I didn't think they'd quit...

dialogues.jp: どうしよう。環に悪いことをした。
dialogues.en: What should I do... I've done something horrible to Tamaki.
dialogues.text: What should I do... I've done something horrible to Tamaki.

dialogues.jp: 俺の顔が、相当へこんでいるように見えたのか、
dialogues.en:
The two remaining club members apparently saw my face go
white.
dialogues.text:
The two remaining club members apparently saw my face go
white.

dialogues.speaker: Club Member 1
dialogues.jp:
「気にすることはないですよ。みんな、巫女装
　束を着てみたかっただけの人達ばかりでした
　から」
dialogues.en:
"Don't worry about it. That bunch were only interested in
how good the Miko outfit looked on them."
dialogues.text:
"Don't worry about it. That bunch were only interested in
how good the Miko outfit looked on them."

dialogues.speaker: Club Member 2
dialogues.jp:
「あたし達は、やっぱり先輩に憧れて入ってき
　た訳だし、巫女さんにも興味あるしね」
dialogues.en:
"We're more interested in Miko themselves, and want to be
like senpai."
dialogues.text:
"We're more interested in Miko themselves, and want to be
like senpai."

dialogues.speaker: Club Member
dialogues.jp:
「そうそう。胡ノ宮先輩、早く良くなってくれ
　るといいんだけど」
dialogues.en: "Uh huh. Hopefully Konomiya-senpai will get better soon."
dialogues.text: "Uh huh. Hopefully Konomiya-senpai will get better soon."

dialogues.jp: と、二人は和やかに笑っていた。
dialogues.en: The two of them laughed gently.
dialogues.text: The two of them laughed gently.

dialogues.jp: 「早くって……、環から連絡があったの？」
dialogues.en: "Get better soon... she told you two?"
dialogues.text: "Get better soon... she told you two?"

dialogues.speaker: Club Member 2
dialogues.jp:
「ええ。どうしても体調が優れないのでしばら
　く休ませて欲しいって」
dialogues.en:
"Yeah. Her condition still seemed bad, so she went back to
rest."
dialogues.text:
"Yeah. Her condition still seemed bad, so she went back to
rest."

dialogues.speaker: Club Member 1
dialogues.jp: 「今日も、ほとんどあたし達の自主練です」
dialogues.en: "We're having self-study today."
dialogues.text: "We're having self-study today."

dialogues.speaker: Club Member 1
dialogues.jp: 「そうか……」
dialogues.en: "I see."
dialogues.text: "I see."

dialogues.jp: やっぱり、良くなってなかったんだ。
dialogues.en: She still isn't feeling well, huh.
dialogues.text: She still isn't feeling well, huh.

dialogues.jp:
昨日、神社に送ったときも、ずっと顔色悪かっ
たからな……。
dialogues.en:
Until I left the shrine, she didn't look like she was
improving...
dialogues.text:
Until I left the shrine, she didn't look like she was
improving...

dialogues.speaker: Club Member 2
dialogues.jp:
「なんか、相当良くないみたいですね。電話し
　てきたのも、本人じゃありませんでしたから」
dialogues.en:
"She really sounded bad. Even over the phone, I couldn't
tell it was her."
dialogues.text:
"She really sounded bad. Even over the phone, I couldn't
tell it was her."

dialogues.speaker: Club Member 1
dialogues.jp:
「朝倉先輩、お見舞いに行った方がいいんじゃ
　ないですか？　彼女さんなんでしょう？」
dialogues.en:
"Asakura-senpai, you should go visit her. She's your
girlfriend, right?"
dialogues.text:
"Asakura-senpai, you should go visit her. She's your
girlfriend, right?"

dialogues.speaker: Club Member 1
dialogues.jp: 「……え？　あ、あの、その」
dialogues.en: "...Ehh? U, um, that's..."
dialogues.text: "...Ehh? U, um, that's..."

dialogues.jp:
……やっぱり、バレてたか。つか、他に俺がい
る状況はあり得ないか。
dialogues.en:
...Looks like we've been found out. It would've been
impossible to keep secret anyway.
dialogues.text:
...Looks like we've been found out. It would've been
impossible to keep secret anyway.

dialogues.jp: 「ありがとう。俺、ちょっと様子見てみるわ」
dialogues.en: "Thanks. I'd go see her right now."
dialogues.text: "Thanks. I'd go see her right now."

dialogues.speaker: Club Member 1
dialogues.jp: 「はい、お願いします」
dialogues.en: "Send her our regards as well."
dialogues.text: "Send her our regards as well."

dialogues.speaker: Club Member 2
dialogues.jp:
「あたし達は、あたし達でちゃんとやってます
　から心配しないでくださいって伝えておいて
　ください」
dialogues.en:
"Let her know that we will do what we can, so please don't
worry."
dialogues.text:
"Let her know that we will do what we can, so please don't
worry."

dialogues.speaker: Club Member 2
dialogues.jp: 「おう」
dialogues.en: "Got it."
dialogues.text: "Got it."

dialogues.jp: 俺は、二人に礼を言って、部室を後にした。
dialogues.en: With one final word of thanks, I left the clubroom.
dialogues.text: With one final word of thanks, I left the clubroom.

dialogues.jp:
やっぱり、わかってくれてる人達は、ちゃんと
環のことをわかってくれてるんだよなぁ。
dialogues.en:
It's appropriate that the ones who know about us are the
ones who know her best.
dialogues.text:
It's appropriate that the ones who know about us are the
ones who know her best.

dialogues.jp:
俺は、扉の向こうのふたりに、そっと頭を下げ
た。
dialogues.en: I looked at them through the doorway again, and bowed.
dialogues.text: I looked at them through the doorway again, and bowed.

dialogues.jp: 『様子を見てくる』
dialogues.en: "Go visit her."
dialogues.text: "Go visit her."

dialogues.jp:
とは言ったものの、今行くと、逆に気を遣わせ
てしまうんじゃないだろうか……。
dialogues.en:
Although having said that, it might not be a good idea to
disrupt her rest.
dialogues.text:
Although having said that, it might not be a good idea to
disrupt her rest.

dialogues.jp: そんな思いで、しばし悩んでいる。
dialogues.en: I tried to think about it carefully.
dialogues.text: I tried to think about it carefully.

dialogues.jp: ──やっぱり、心配だよな。
dialogues.en: --But in the end, I was too worried.
dialogues.text: --But in the end, I was too worried.

dialogues.jp: 見舞いに行こう。
dialogues.en: I'd go see how she's doing.
dialogues.text: I'd go see how she's doing.

dialogues.jp: と、その前に、一応電話で連絡してみるか。
dialogues.en: I'd give her a call first though.
dialogues.text: I'd give her a call first though.

dialogues.jp: ダイヤルし終わり、コール音が鳴る。
dialogues.en: I dialed her number, and waited for her response.
dialogues.text: I dialed her number, and waited for her response.

dialogues.jp:
この、相手が出るかどうか待つ時間も、結構、
緊張する。
dialogues.en: Each second seemed more like a minute of nervousness.
dialogues.text: Each second seemed more like a minute of nervousness.

dialogues.jp: ５回コールで相手が出た。
dialogues.en: Finally after 5 rings, someone picked up.
dialogues.text: Finally after 5 rings, someone picked up.

dialogues.speaker: Voice
dialogues.jp: 『もしもし』
dialogues.en: "Hello."
dialogues.text: "Hello."

dialogues.jp: あ、環じゃない。
dialogues.en: Ah, it isn't Tamaki...
dialogues.text: Ah, it isn't Tamaki...

dialogues.jp:
誰だ？　女の人の声だ。それにしては声が若い。
お母さんはいないはずだから……、まさかお父
さんっ！？
dialogues.en:
Who is it? It's a female voice, and it sounds young. She
doesn't have a mother... it can't be her father!?
dialogues.text:
Who is it? It's a female voice, and it sounds young. She
doesn't have a mother... it can't be her father!?

dialogues.jp: って、女の人だっつってんだろ、俺。
dialogues.en: ...Pah, I'm thinking just like a girl.
dialogues.text: ...Pah, I'm thinking just like a girl.

dialogues.jp: 「あの、朝倉と申しますが、環さんは……？」
dialogues.en: "Hello, this is Asakura. Can I speak to Tamaki...?"
dialogues.text: "Hello, this is Asakura. Can I speak to Tamaki...?"

dialogues.speaker: Voice
dialogues.jp: 『はい、少々お待ち下さい』
dialogues.en: "Please hold on a moment."
dialogues.text: "Please hold on a moment."

dialogues.jp: 『エリーゼのために』の保留音が流れる。
dialogues.en: The hold tone of "For Elizabeth" poured through my ears.
dialogues.text: The hold tone of "For Elizabeth" poured through my ears.

dialogues.jp:
俺は聞きなれた旋律を頭で追いながら、環が出
るのを待つ。
dialogues.en:
I completely ignored the music, waiting for Tamaki to
answer.
dialogues.text:
I completely ignored the music, waiting for Tamaki to
answer.

dialogues.jp: Ａパートが二回繰り返された後、相手が出た。
dialogues.en: Just as the A part was about to loop, the music ended.
dialogues.text: Just as the A part was about to loop, the music ended.

dialogues.en: "Ah, Tamaki..."
dialogues.text: "Ah, Tamaki..."

dialogues.speaker: Voice
dialogues.jp:
『申し訳ありません、環さんはお休みのようで
　すので、お取り次ぎが出来ません』
dialogues.en:
"I'm sorry, Tamaki-san is resting and unable to come to the
phone."
dialogues.text:
"I'm sorry, Tamaki-san is resting and unable to come to the
phone."

dialogues.speaker: Voice
dialogues.jp: 「あ、じゃあ、あの……」
dialogues.en: "Ah, then, um..."
dialogues.text: "Ah, then, um..."

dialogues.speaker: Voice
dialogues.jp: 「……それでは失礼いたします」
dialogues.en: "...Please excuse me."
dialogues.text: "...Please excuse me."

dialogues.jp: ──ブチッ。
dialogues.en: --*click*
dialogues.text: --*click*

dialogues.jp:
俺が何か言おうとするのを｛さえぎ／遮｝って、電話が切れ
る。
dialogues.en: Before I could finish my sentence, she hung up on me.
dialogues.text: Before I could finish my sentence, she hung up on me.

dialogues.jp: なんだよ……。
dialogues.en: Geez, what's wrong with her...
dialogues.text: Geez, what's wrong with her...

dialogues.jp: 話ぐらい、聞いてくれてもいいのに……。
dialogues.en: I just wanted to ask her something...
dialogues.text: I just wanted to ask her something...

dialogues.jp:
でも、環が寝てるとなると、神社に行くのはよ
した方が良さそうだな……。
dialogues.en:
In any case, if Tamaki's sleeping, it'd be better for me not
to go to the shirne.
dialogues.text:
In any case, if Tamaki's sleeping, it'd be better for me not
to go to the shirne.

dialogues.jp: 環に無理をさせることになる。
dialogues.en: She'd try and push herself for me again.
dialogues.text: She'd try and push herself for me again.

dialogues.jp: 今日は仕方ない、我慢するか。
dialogues.en: I'd just have to bear it for today.
dialogues.text: I'd just have to bear it for today.

dialogues.jp:
会って『元気出せ』って、見舞ってやりたい気
持ちを堪えて、俺は受話器を置いた。
dialogues.en: Supressing my want to visit her, I put back the receiver.
dialogues.text: Supressing my want to visit her, I put back the receiver.

dialogues.jp: ◆やめてしまった部員達◆
dialogues.en: ◆Quitting Club Members?◆
dialogues.text: ◆Quitting Club Members?◆

dialogues.jp:
環の身体と巫女部の様子が心配になり、部室へ
行くと、部員が二人だけになっている。
dialogues.en:
Worried about Tamaki and the state of the Miko Club, I
checked the clubroom, and found only two people inside.
dialogues.text:
Worried about Tamaki and the state of the Miko Club, I
checked the clubroom, and found only two people inside.

dialogues.jp: 聞けば、みんなやめてしまったとのこと。
dialogues.en: I heard from them that the other members all quit.
dialogues.text: I heard from them that the other members all quit.

dialogues.jp:
おまけに、環は身体の具合が悪く、部活を休ん
でいるらしい。
dialogues.en:
On top of that, Tamaki was still doing badly, and appeared
to be resting from club activities.
dialogues.text:
On top of that, Tamaki was still doing badly, and appeared
to be resting from club activities.

dialogues.jp:
俺は、見舞いに行こうと自宅に電話をするが、
眠っているからと取り次いでもらえなかった。
dialogues.en:
I phoned her house thinking of visiting her, but was
informed that she was sleeping.
dialogues.text:
I phoned her house thinking of visiting her, but was
informed that she was sleeping.

dialogues.jp: 今回は見舞いに行くの、我慢しよう。
dialogues.en: I'd just bear not visiting her for today.
dialogues.text: I'd just bear not visiting her for today.
